statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a known history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The patient has a concurrent diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Diagnosis codes Z86.73, I34.0, and I49.9 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to characterize the rhythm disturbance and assess for potential embolic risk factors
